title: Candice Local Preferences
description: The small local preference profile persisted per OS user. This is never project/conversation memory: the active Claude skill/project files remain the durable source of truth for project decisions and answers. Versioned for migration (WS-34). Candice Master Spec section 9. Version: 1.0.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the preferences schema. Bumped by the integration/release owner only (manifest 9.4 class 2); WS-34 provides migrations.

preferredName.description: The user's stated preferred name, asked at most once per local OS user (spec 4). Never inferred from the OS username. Null until asked. Changeable later.

voiceOutputEnabled.description: Voice responses ON/OFF. Independent of answer method: every combination of voice/typed input and voiced/muted output must work (spec 5.2).

lastUsedAnswerMethod.description: Remembered convenience only; never a lock. Every question still offers both HOLD TO TALK and TYPE ANSWER (spec 5.1).

reducedMotion.description: Null = follow OS reduced-motion setting; true = force minimal animation; false = animations allowed (spec 10).

x.description: Screen x offset in points relative to the bound terminal anchor, or free position when floating.

anchor.description: Anchoring preference beside the bound terminal, or independent movable floating mode (Accessibility denied fallback).

companionScreenPosition.description: Remembered preferred offset; the user may always reposition.

lastUsedSkill.description: Optional last-used supported skill, for the companion's convenience only.
